key_insight: An H²-based equilibrated residual framework provides guaranteed finite element error control and polynomial-degree-robust a posteriori lower bounds.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports reliable error assessment for plate bending, Poisson problems, and mixed linear elasticity, including stress-error control.
method: Decompose vector- and tensor-valued Sobolev spaces into H² and H¹ components.
Reconstruct symmetric, piecewise-polynomial tensors on vertex patches in broken H(div div) spaces.
Use equilibrated residuals to estimate biharmonic energy error, Poisson L² error, and mixed-elasticity stress error.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments illustrate estimator effectiveness, but the abstract provides no quantitative accuracy or computational-cost results.
watch_item: Implementation requires specialized local tensor reconstruction; its computational overhead is not quantified in the abstract.
